biography.plain_text: Akın Öngör is a Turkish banker and wine producer who led Garanti Bank from 1991 to 2000. The son of a doctor and a teacher, he studied business administration at Middle East Technical University before a career in industrial marketing and banking. After retiring, he founded Selendi's vineyards in Akhisar.

confidence.reason: Publisher biography and direct family interview support the career, education, parents and vineyard foundation.

long_biography.plain_text:
A round table was one of Akın Öngör's tools for changing Garanti Bank. As chief executive, he brought senior managers together every Monday to make decisions jointly, challenging entrenched divisions between their departments. The changes took years; he later recorded the experience in Benden Sonra Devam, a book about building an organisation that could continue succeeding after his departure.

Winemaking presented a different set of decisions. Seeking better grape-growing conditions for Selendi, he installed a weather station before developing vineyards in the surrounding hills. The family worked with international specialists and expanded beyond its original plot, growing organic grapes for wines made and bottled on the estate.

uncertainties: Research cutoff 30 September 2026; accessed 1 October 2026. No live changes were made.
Bank market capitalisation and assets belong to the bank, not its former executive. The original personal wealth inference rests on compensation, savings and the documented retirement mechanism.

Current wine-sector materiality rests on a substantial founded family production enterprise, capital investment and continued land development. Family share percentages and the size of retained financial savings are unpublished; Food & Beverage is a medium-confidence principal-interest inference. Finance & Investments was considered as an origin-sector fallback if the current evidence were insufficient.

The independent-start subtype is supported positively by his direct statements and concrete self-funded employment beginning. Public-service parents and education are not silently treated as proof of poverty; neither is ordinary professional mentoring equated with substantial family advantage.

Selendi began at hobby scale with charitable intentions. Subsequent enterprise investment, growing production and ongoing acquisitions support a material business today; the early description is not treated as a permanent limit. Founder concerns the current wine platform, not ownership of Garanti Bank.
His publisher distinguishes the end of CEO service in 2000 from later board roles. The existing Wikipedia retirement wording is less precise. No correction to the immutable vessel dates is attempted.

Birth year is directly supported. Exact day, month, additional nationality and a cleanly mapped middle name remain unverified. Yavuz Akin appears in independently linked personal accounts, but Yavuz precedes the input given name and is not silently inserted as a middle name. A Zonguldak birth lead from an archival newspaper could not be retrieved reliably enough for a proposal; modern derivative Ankara claims were not adopted.

An exact-name US investment-litigation lead was considered, but no sufficiently independent biographical bridge was established. Its residence, allegations and financial holdings are not attributed to this owner. No legal PDF screenshot was successfully inspected, and no legal conclusion relies on it.

Only the company and independently cross-linked LinkedIn are proposed; existing Wikipedia is retained without duplication.

No matching public Instagram, Facebook or Twitter account was established; TikTok access was restricted. Direct LinkedIn content was restricted, but two professional cross-links identify the exact account.

The regional producer page translates the vineyard area inconsistently and reports different product counts in its text and portfolio panel. No acreage or product-count proposal relies on it. Its dated acquisitions and production method corroborate the material operation.
Only Banking and Wine production are assigned. Competitive basketball, educational giving and institutional service remain ordinary contextual facts rather than generating additional marginal tags.
